look: Crystal Jelly, a D-rank GKOM variant from the Gloam Oozes family: wobbling translucent flan-like jelly with a red orb at its centre. Family anatomy: translucent jellies and gel cubes with half-dissolved crystal shards drifting inside. Build: compact and agile. GKOM rank cue: GKOM crystals crust its joints and run along the spine; about a quarter of the body crystallised; the crystals are murky violet gel crystal. Element Water: aqua, deep blue and pearl accents, modest ribbons of water, bubbles and moonlit spray
